Definition: to end (in the sense of completion or failure)
BiblicalUsage: Gamar means to end, to complete, or to fail. The LORD will perfect that which concerns me, says the psalmist in Psalms 138:8, and God performs all things for me in Psalms 57:2. But the word also fails: the godly man ceases and the faithful fail in Psalms 12:1, and the psalmist asks whether God's promise fails for evermore in Psalms 77:8.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two ends of this word meet in God alone. Men fail and promises seem to end, but the LORD perfects what concerns me, and I hold that His mercy endures for ever while ours runs out.
